'''''Study of the Galactic Balance of Power: The New Order's Greatest Challenges''''' was a publication written by [[Kaelldin Krothburt]] and published by [[DataLine Press]]. It was restricted to government access. It was about the challenges faced by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in the face of the growing combat experience of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as well as [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
